{{#invoke:Aurebesh|regular|size={{#if:{{{size|}}}|{{{size}}}|}}}}<noinclude>
==Usage==
<code><nowiki>{{Aur|letter #1|letter #2|letter #3|letter #4|letter #5|</nowiki>''etc.''}}</code>

===Note on punctuation===
Aurebesh differentiates between left and right single and double quotation marks/apostrophes, therefore passing a bare " or ' to this template will not work. Either pass them as <code>"l</code> and <code>"r</code> (for left and right double quotes), and <code>'l</code> and <code>'r</code> (for left and right single quotes or apostrophes), or use curly quotes (<code>“”‘’</code>).

For a full list of supported characters, see the <code>chars</code> table at [[Module:Aurebesh/data]].

===Other Notes===
*For writing in bolded Aurebesh, see [[Template:AurB]].
*This template is '''not''' case sensitive.
*Remember to leave [[Wikipedia:digraphs|digraphs]] (ch, ae, oo, eo, kh, ng, sh, th) together.
*This template only works properly with normal-sized (10 pt) font.

==Example==
Aurebesh &rArr; {{Aur|a|u|r|e|b|e|sh}}

===Code===
<tt><nowiki>{{Aur|a|u|r|e|b|e|sh}}</nowiki></tt>

===Result===
{{Aur|a|u|r|e|b|e|sh}}
